text:
Alex Cheng: FYI I'm getting pages from the incident bot about GPU queue backlog and autoscale not coming up. Customer errors spiking.
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: high-severity: gpu-pool-az1 exhausted, queue growth observed, HPA target not reacting. Pager duty: @Sam Ortiz oncall.
Sam Ortiz: I'm on it, looking at HPA and metrics adapter right now.
Priya Menon: Debugging Prometheus -> metrics adapter. We've seen high scrape latencies earlier today after the config push.
Maya Rivera: Can you paste the HPA state? I want to see desired vs current replicas.
Sam Ortiz: kubectl -n inference get hpa gpu-inference-hpa -o yaml
Sam Ortiz: ```
behaviour:
  scaleDown: {}
metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      current:
        averageUtilization: 70
status:
  currentReplicas: 6
  desiredReplicas: 6
  lastScaleTime: null
``` 
Sam Ortiz: HPA is stuck at 6 but queues are growing on the serving side.
Jin Kim: What's the queue metric HPA uses? Is it custom from prometheus-adapter? If adapter is lagging HPA won't see the backlog.
Priya Menon: Yeah HPA is using a custom metric `inference_queue_length` via prometheus-adapter. Adapter logs show backpressure.
Priya Menon: infra-bot: prometheus-adapter queue backlog = 13400, scrape backlog = 120m, last forwarded metric timestamp 1758885850
infra-bot: prometheus: scrape_runtime_seconds increased, adapter: 503 on /metrics query.
Maya Rivera: That explains it. If adapter returns 503 or stale metrics HPA will treat metric as missing and not scale (or default to safe behavior).
Alex Cheng: Customer impact: some long-tail requests time out and a couple of customers reported 429/timeout. Customer-signal-bot shows spike in SLO alerts.
customer-signal-bot: 33 unique customers impacted, 1200 failed requests in last 10m, top regions: us-west-2, eu-central-1
Sam Ortiz: Mitigation plan: 1) Take quick static scale to relieve queue. 2) Fix metrics pipeline so HPA can observe queue and scale automatically. 3) Post-incident: revert questionable scrape config.
Priya Menon: Agree. I'm going to restart prometheus-adapter pods to clear adapter backlog and confirm if metrics resume.
Jin Kim: I'll request an emergency capacity increase for the Dedicated pool and manually scale GPUs in the cluster: kubectl scale deployment/gpu-inference --replicas=12
Maya Rivera: Please be careful with quotas; alert infra so we don't hit instance limits. Also enable surge autoscaling if possible.
Sam Ortiz: Executing manual scale now.
Sam Ortiz: ```
kubectl scale deployment/gpu-inference --replicas=12 -n inference
# scaling triggered by oncall to relieve immediate queue
``` 
Sam Ortiz: Manual scale done, pods starting. Queue length dropping from 18k to ~6k based on in-pod logs.
Priya Menon: Restarting prometheus-adapter (graceful) to flush the queue.
Priya Menon: ```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring
kubectl get pods -l app=prometheus-adapter -n monitoring
``` 
infra-bot: prometheus-adapter pod 3/3 ready after restart, backlog processing resumed.
Priya Menon: Adapter metrics now reflect current queue: `inference_queue_length` = 6100 -> 1200 -> trending down.
Maya Rivera: HPA observed the custom metric and desired replicas bumped to 10, current 12 (manual scale). Good.
Sam Ortiz: Confirming customer errors falling. customer-signal-bot shows failures down to 120 in last 10m.
customer-signal-bot: impacted customers now 9, failed requests 120 in last 10m.
Alex Cheng: On-call handoff: I'll stay through the mitigation window and then hand to Maya for postmortem.
Maya Rivera: I'll take the postmortem and coordinate the revert of the scrape config. Need the exact config change that triggered higher scrape times.
Priya Menon: The config change was an increase in scrape_interval for a noisy job? Actually a change added a high-cardinality label to a workload which multiplied series.
Jin Kim: We should roll back that label expansion and add relabeling to drop it. Also add adapter circuit-breaker and metrics buffer limits so backlog doesn't block HPA entirely.
Sam Ortiz: For immediate follow-up: set an alert when prometheus-adapter queue > 2000 and HPA desired/current divergence > 3 for 5m.
Alex Cheng: Agree. Create tickets: INC-#### for immediate config rollback, INC-#### for adapter resilience improvements, and SEV-PR for customer outreach.
Maya Rivera: I'll file postmortem and notify CSMs for affected customers. Also recommend temporary SLA credits if customers request.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — manual scale + adapter restart. Root cause suspected: prometheus scrape cardinality spike + adapter throttling.
Alex Cheng: Thanks everyone. I'll update status page and run the post-incident blameless review tomorrow.
Maya Rivera: Handoff to me complete, leaving notes in the incident doc. :thumbsup:
